born.why: The code prioritizes survival by eating when hunger is critical, avoids known poisons definitively, carries known safe fruits to optimize foraging efficiency, and cautiously tastes sweet-smelling unknowns only when not starving to expand dietary knowledge without excessive risk.

This code refines memory decay for faster adaptation to changing fruit safety, uses trait generalization cautiously to identify safe species, and prioritizes carrying beneficial fruits when not starving while strictly avoiding known poisons unless near death.

The code prioritizes survival by strictly avoiding specific known poisons and general recent danger signals, while efficiently consuming proven beneficial foods and exploring unknowns only when safe enough to risk a small taste.

The code improves safety by using recency-weighted learning to distinguish safe from poisonous fruits based on shared traits, prioritizing carrying known good foods and avoiding known bad ones, while only tasting when hungry or uncertain to balance survival and exploration.

The code prioritizes eating proven safe fruits or the target, avoids known poisons and similar-looking ones, and only risks tasting unknown fruits when hungry enough to justify the danger, ensuring survival through cautious exploration.

This code prioritizes survival by treating 'eat' as a last resort for extreme hunger, uses 'taste' to actively gather data on unknown sweet fruits without full commitment, and introduces 'carry' to stockpile known-safe items efficiently, while strictly avoiding confirmed poisonous species.
